evidence: Full pytest suite passed after the single-state-seed and decoder-search changes
Ruff, compileall, and git diff --check passed
RTX 4080 Laptop bf16 smoke passed at batch 8 with 7.84 GB peak memory and zero repeated-inference probability error
Current identity preflight verified 13 immutable v2/canonical input hashes
Real nine-fragment session replay produced zero error for motion, PPG, quality, validity, alignment, long-context indices, and statistics tensors
Raw-session replay inferred 100 Hz motion and 50 Hz PPG without gaps over three seconds
Strict IoU greater than 0.25, subject-disjoint nested OOF, ignore masking, 60-second maximum future context, and no-XGBoost prediction constraints remain enforced
Direct state training now uses seed 2026 only while preserving three verifier and boundary seeds for the cheaper downstream stability checks
State selector uses one fixed decoder configuration; nested and pooled OOF use a compact 48-configuration preregistered decoder search
Resolved config and manifests record the single state seed, three downstream seeds, subject lineage, parent hashes, and worktree fingerprint
Bundle export and loading accept only registered one-state-seed or three-state-seed profiles and cross-check resolved config when available
Interrupted prior run names cannot resume because result-affecting config hashes changed
This is a pre-training readiness review; no completed full-fold result is claimed
Bundle privacy, hash-manifest, and no-XGBoost replay paths remain covered by the passing test suite

findings.title: Direct state training multiplied the dominant compute by three seeds
Reducing physical batch size silently halved clips and optimizer updates per epoch
The 1620-case decoder grid repeated inside nested OOF and made the direct route impractical
Single-seed training was incompatible with final export and bundle loading
A single state seed removes ensemble variance reduction
Official one-to-one matching and submission adapter remain unknown
